snippet.title: Weeny Wise Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi everyone!
This is a new version of Weeny Wise reveal trailer! In this version, we have improved the lighting and shaders, and this trailer also includes new music and footages. Also, you can get to know the main voice actor of our characters, Triya Leong!
We are very eager to know what you think about the new version of the trailer.

"""Now you can watch the 'Story Trailer':"""
https://youtu.be/kXwPNrDLRK8?si=AyYf30f6FesdYrYg

Also, if you like the game, you can add it to your WISHLIST on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2820270/Weeny_Wise/?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=YouTube&utm_campaign=YouTube

What is Weeny Wise❓
Weeny Wise is a co-op, adventure, puzzle-platformer and exploration game that has an original lore, and you and your companion join the main characters of the game named Anneli and Hugo to progress your adventure in the world of small and magical creatures called Weeny Wise.

#indiegame #coopgames
